doc.editSaveHint: Edits are auto-saved to a local draft; ⌘S writes to the knowledge base
doc.blockNotFound: The source block no longer exists
doc.blockNotFoundDescription: It may have been edited or deleted after this point
doc.inboxDescription: This document is in the inbox and won't appear under “All documents”. Promote it to a note once you've tidied it up.
doc.archivedDescription: This document is archived and won't appear under “All documents”; AI answers no longer cite it by default.
doc.aiHiddenNoTitle: Hidden from AI — title cannot be generated
doc.archiveTooltip: After archiving it won't appear under “All documents” and AI answers won't cite it by default; you can restore it anytime
doc.aiExcludeTooltip: When hidden, AI can no longer index or retrieve this document (you can still search and edit it in the Web UI)
doc.aiExcludeDescription: It won't be indexed, retrieved, or auto-linked by AI; external tools can't read it either. You can still search and edit it in the Web UI.
doc.confirmDeleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this document? You can undo it from the toast at the bottom-right.
doc.confirmRevertSnapshot: Revert to this full-document snapshot? The body and title will be restored to this version; the current content will be kept as a new history version.
doc.confirmRevertBlock: Revert to this block version? Only this content block will be restored; the current content will be kept as a new history version.
doc.noHistory: No history yet. Every edit leaves a revertible version here.
doc.historyDescription: Full-document snapshots revert body and title; block-level edits only revert that content block.
